member.name: T:Jeninnet.FileQuery.CommandLine.PatternSplitter
member.summary:
Provides utilities for parsing lists of pattern expressions from a single input string.
This parser is responsible only for splitting and normalizing multi-pattern input.
Typical usage:
var patterns = PatternSplitter.Split("*.cs;!bin/**");
Separators are configurable and default to semicolon (;). Empty entries are removed automatically.

member.name: F:Jeninnet.FileQuery.CommandLine.PatternSplitter.DEFAULT_PATTERN_SEPARATOR
member.summary: The default character used to separate multiple patterns in a string.

member.name: M:Jeninnet.FileQuery.CommandLine.PatternSplitter.Split(System.String,System.Char)
member.summary:
Splits a multi-pattern string into individual pattern expressions.
This method does not interpret escape sequences or quoting rules. It is intended for simple, configuration-style pattern lists.
member.param: The character used to separate patterns. Defaults to ';'.
member.returns: A sequence of individual pattern strings, trimmed and with empty entries removed.

member.name: M:Jeninnet.FileQuery.CommandLine.PatternSplitter.Split(System.String,System.Char[])
member.summary:
Splits a multi-pattern string using multiple possible separators.
This overload is useful when accepting user input from CLI or configuration files where separators may vary (e.g., ',', ';', or whitespace).
member.param: A set of characters used to separate patterns.
member.returns: A sequence of individual pattern strings, trimmed and with empty entries removed.
